decoded.meaning: The node-identity record served by read <vertex>:identity (reference/05 §:identity): SETTINGS{ NAME "kind" VALUE u8=0x01 (ed25519), NAME "key" VALUE <32 bytes> }, the 60-byte ed25519 form. The key is the recognisable 00..1F, not a real public key.
decoded.note: Structured TLV, opt.PL=1, no trailers (at-rest form).
